sketch_notes: The sketches imply a relatively simple content-first blog/article page with long scrolling content, but responsive behavior adds meaningful JS needs: mobile likely hides navigation behind a menu and may compress search/header controls, while desktop emphasizes persistent header context over a long reading surface. Most explicit interaction is only weakly drawn, so the strongest cross-viewport requirements are search behavior, sticky header handling, and accessibility-focused focus management for any expanding or overlay UI introduced in implementation.
